build_FID_metric: build a FrechetInceptionDistance metric instance with a specified inception feature layer
update_FID_with_real_images: update the FID metric with real image tensors by calling update with real=True
update_FID_with_fake_images: update the FID metric with fake image tensors by calling update with real=False
compute_FID_score: compute the final FID score from accumulated real and fake features using compute
compute_fid_from_features: compute FID directly from real and fake feature tensors using _compute_fid_from_features
